sidi-heated-bed-assembly.alt: CAD model of the heated print bed raised on its scissor linkage, with components beneath it in the base.
sidi-heated-bed-assembly.caption: Full assembly model with the platform raised and base components shown beneath the linkage.

sidi-lift-linkage.alt: Isometric CAD view showing the heated bed platform, crossed lift arms, and rectangular base frame.
sidi-lift-linkage.caption: Mechanical CAD view showing the crossed links between the print platform and base frame.

sidi-heater-pcb.alt: Green PCB layout with closely spaced traces covering most of the board.
sidi-heater-pcb.caption: Resistive heater PCB layout, showing traces spread across the board.

sidi-pcb-layout.alt: PCB layout showing traces, a central component footprint, and test pads along the edges.
sidi-pcb-layout.caption: PCB layout detail showing component connections and test pads.

combat-robot-build.alt: Overhead workbench photo of the assembled robot with a scuffed metal top plate and front spinner.
combat-robot-build.caption: The assembled robot on the workbench. The front spinner sits in the opening in the metal top plate.

combat-robot-cad-top.alt: Onshape assembly viewed from above, showing the top plate, chassis, and front-mounted vertical spinner.
combat-robot-cad-top.caption: Onshape top view. The top plate wraps around the opening for the front spinner.

combat-robot-cad-underside.alt: Onshape assembly viewed from below, with two drive wheels visible through the bottom of the chassis.
combat-robot-cad-underside.caption: Onshape underside view. The two drive wheels sit inside the chassis footprint.

car.alt: Longhorn Baja Racing car 185 on grass, photographed from the front quarter.
car.caption: Car 185, assembled in its competition configuration.

hill.alt: Car 185 lifts its front wheels on the hill-climb course.
hill.caption: Car 185 on the hill climb at Baja SAE Ohio.

rear.alt: Rear of car 185 with the engine and suspension beneath the number plate.
rear.caption: Rear of car 185. The frame, engine, and suspension show the packaging space on the previous competition car.

side.alt: Orange riveted side panel, cockpit, and rear suspension.
side.caption: The finished side panel follows the lower frame rail beside the cockpit.

firewall.alt: Aluminum cockpit firewall, harness openings, and car number 185.
firewall.caption: Cockpit layout with the firewall and shoulder-harness openings visible.

column.alt: Team members holding a frame tube in place next to a digital angle gauge.
column.caption: The team checks the tube angle during fit-up.

rack-side.alt: Steering rack attachment between the front frame tubes in the shop.
rack-side.caption: Steering rack attachment viewed through the front frame.

rack-front.alt: Steering rack and brake lines installed together inside the front frame.
rack-front.caption: The steering rack shares the front bay with the brake plumbing.

cad.alt: CAD assembly of the rear chassis, drivetrain, and wheel.
cad.caption: Vehicle assembly in CAD. The rear frame defines the available envelope for the CVT and drive components.

baja-vehicle-cad.alt: Side-view CAD of car 185 showing the driver cage, rear engine, and suspension.
baja-vehicle-cad.caption: Full-vehicle CAD from the design paper. The engine and CVT sit behind the driver inside the rear frame.

baja-spaceframe.alt: Isometric CAD of the bare tubular spaceframe for car 185.
baja-spaceframe.caption: The spaceframe locates the suspension pickups, driver seat, steering rack, and engine mounts.

baja-rear-suspension.alt: Rear suspension CAD showing the trailing arms, shocks, differential, and CV axles.
baja-rear-suspension.caption: The rear CV axle doubles as a lower locating link in the semi-trailing-arm layout.

ratios.alt: Engineering spreadsheet comparing engine, CVT, gearing, and vehicle inputs.
ratios.caption: Gear-ratio worksheet. Speed and torque values are calculated estimates from the listed inputs.

thermal.alt: Simulation mesh and temperature contours in the CVT housing cross-section.
thermal.caption: Simulated temperature distribution for the 3 mm wall configuration at high rotational speed.

marshals.alt: Race marshals gathered beside the circuit in white uniforms.
marshals.caption: Race marshals together at the circuit.

civic-deck-layout.alt: The Civic’s open trunk with the revised rectangular deck sketched over the cargo floor in blue.
civic-deck-layout.caption: Revised layout. The deck follows a straight path through the trunk opening.

civic-trunk-measurements.alt: Trunk photo with a 40-inch width in red, a 36-inch depth in blue, and a 2.25-inch vertical measurement in green.
civic-trunk-measurements.caption: Measurements taken inside my Civic with the rear seats folded.

civic-wide-layout.alt: The first deck outline widens into the pockets on both sides of the trunk.
civic-wide-layout.caption: First layout. The side tabs used more of the trunk width but complicated installation.

civic-passenger-layout.alt: Side view of the folded rear seat with the extension and its proposed support legs drawn in blue.
civic-passenger-layout.caption: Side-door sketch showing where the deck extends beyond the folded seat.

civic-supports-cad.alt: Three parallel wooden supports modeled in CAD.
civic-supports-cad.caption: Three support members beneath the trunk deck.

civic-assembly-cad.alt: CAD view of the plywood sleeping deck resting on its supports.
civic-assembly-cad.caption: CAD assembly of the trunk section with the plywood deck in place.

mhm-printer.caption: The printer and its work area during an electrode run.

mhm-electrode-samples.alt: Four labeled electrode samples on a sheet of foil.

mhm-separator-profile.alt: One white separator with a square window and two curved side notches.

mhm-foil-profile.alt: A thin silver-colored cutout with a square opening and a notch on each side.
